prompt: Build a multi-vendor artisanal food marketplace using Next.js, NestJS, and PostgreSQL where local bakeries can register merchant accounts, manage inventory, accept Stripe split payments, and let customers track live courier deliveries on a dashboard.
label_reason: Requires both a customer/merchant web interface in Next.js and a NestJS backend with PostgreSQL storage, user authentication, and Stripe payment integration.

prompt: We need an outpatient hospital management system built with React and Django REST Framework backed by MySQL. Doctors must log in with role-based access to update electronic prescriptions, while receptionists schedule appointments and patients view lab results online.
label_reason: Mentioning React and MySQL is part of an end-to-end multi-role clinical application requiring a React UI, Django REST APIs, database persistence, and role-based authentication.

prompt: Create a lightweight internal conference room booking app with a Vue 3 calendar interface and a FastAPI backend storing reservations in SQLite. No login is needed since it runs on our closed office intranet without external third-party services.
label_reason: Requires both a Vue 3 client calendar UI and a FastAPI + SQLite server backend, explicitly excluding authentication and external integrations.

prompt: Develop a B2B SaaS employee onboarding and learning management platform using Angular, Express, and MongoDB. Include OAuth2 SSO via Okta, interactive course progress dashboards, quiz grading endpoints, and automated Slack webhook notifications for HR admins.
label_reason: Covers an Angular learner/admin frontend, Express API backend, MongoDB persistence, Okta SSO authentication, and Slack webhook integration.

prompt: Our community sports tournament app drops live cricket score updates when a match reaches 500 concurrent viewers. Trace and fix the bottleneck across our React Native match screen, Socket.IO Express event emitter, and Redis pub/sub state layer.
label_reason: Debugging spans the React Native client view, Express Socket.IO server communication, and Redis data pub/sub layer.

prompt: Build a neighborhood book-swapping social network where readers sign up with email/password, list books from their personal shelves, chat with nearby members in real time, and browse a map-based feed powered by SvelteKit, Supabase, and the Mapbox API.
label_reason: Requires a full social application with SvelteKit UI, backend/database/authentication via Supabase, and external Mapbox integration.

prompt: Optimize our fleet fuel-consumption portal by adding server-side cursor pagination in Spring Boot and PostgreSQL alongside virtualized scrolling and query caching in the React admin table.
label_reason: Performance optimization touches both the Spring Boot/PostgreSQL backend pagination API and the React frontend virtualized table.

prompt: Build an indie concert ticketing and seat-reservation platform with Next.js, Go (Gin), and PostgreSQL. Enforce strict JWT session rotation, rate-limited checkout endpoints to stop scalper bots, Razorpay payment webhooks, and an interactive SVG venue seat selector.
label_reason: Although security controls like JWT rotation and bot rate limiting are specified, the core task is building a complete ticketing web application across Next.js, Go, and PostgreSQL.

prompt: Create a real-time markdown collaborative note pad using React and a Node.js WebSocket server that keeps active room state purely in server memory for ephemeral 30-minute study sessions without user accounts or database persistence.
label_reason: Requires both a React collaborative editor UI and a stateful Node.js WebSocket server, explicitly avoiding database storage and authentication.

prompt: Implement a veterinary clinic portal with Nuxt, Laravel, and MariaDB where pet owners log in to book vaccination slots, vets record dosage histories, and automated SMS reminders go out via Twilio 24 hours before each visit.
label_reason: Requires a Nuxt frontend for pet owners and vets, a Laravel backend API with MariaDB persistence, user login, and Twilio SMS integration.

prompt: Explain how to architect an end-to-end multi-tenant invoicing application using Remix, Prisma, PostgreSQL, and Auth0 so that tenant data stays isolated across both server loaders and client views.
label_reason: Requests architectural explanation covering both client-side views and server-side loaders, database isolation in PostgreSQL/Prisma, and Auth0 integration.

prompt: Build a personal lending and borrowing ledger web app using React, Express, and MongoDB where users sign in with Google OAuth, log peer-to-peer split transactions, and view monthly repayment balance charts.
label_reason: Requires a React charting and transaction UI, an Express REST backend, MongoDB storage, and Google OAuth authentication.

prompt: When a customer submits a warranty claim with photos on our Angular portal, the Flask API returns a 422 error even though the AWS S3 presigned upload succeeds and the PostgreSQL claim row is partially created. Diagnose and repair both the Angular form payload and Flask handler.
label_reason: Requires debugging and fixing both the Angular client form serialization and the Flask backend API/database/S3 workflow.

prompt: Audit this Express and PostgreSQL order lookup handler for SQL injection vulnerabilities where `req.query.sortBy` and `req.query.merchantId` are concatenated into raw `pool.query()` strings, and document the exploit payloads and remediation report.
label_reason: Focuses exclusively on a SQL injection vulnerability assessment and remediation report for an existing Express/PostgreSQL endpoint without new feature development.

prompt: Perform a DOM-based and stored XSS assessment on our React customer support chat widget, specifically inspecting where agent markdown replies are passed into `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` without DOMPurify sanitization.
label_reason: Requests a targeted XSS security assessment of an existing React component rather than general frontend feature development.

prompt: Review our FastAPI webhook preview service for Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) risks when fetching user-supplied image URLs via `httpx.AsyncClient`, including cloud metadata IP bypasses (`169.254.169.254`) and DNS rebinding vectors.
label_reason: Strictly an SSRF security audit of an existing FastAPI URL-fetching endpoint.

prompt: Assess our multi-tenant Django REST Framework API `/api/v2/invoices/{invoice_id}/download` endpoint for Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) flaws where authenticated users from Organization A can enumerate sequential UUIDs or integers to download Organization B's PDFs.
label_reason: Evaluates an existing API endpoint specifically for IDOR authorization bypass vulnerabilities.

prompt: Conduct a prompt injection and system-prompt leakage assessment on our LangChain customer refund assistant, testing whether indirect instructions embedded inside uploaded return-policy PDFs can trigger unauthorized Stripe refund tool calls.
label_reason: Dedicated security testing for indirect prompt injection and unauthorized tool invocation in an existing LLM agent pipeline.

prompt: Review our Kubernetes ingress, Nginx TLS ciphers, CORS headers, and Docker container security contexts for misconfigurations before our SOC 2 Type II readiness audit, and produce a prioritized vulnerability report.
label_reason: Security configuration review and vulnerability reporting on existing infrastructure with no application development requested.

prompt: Audit our NestJS OAuth2 and JWT refresh-token implementation for authentication flaws, specifically checking for `alg: none` acceptance, missing audience claims, unrevoked refresh token reuse, and CSRF exposure on cookie-backed endpoints.
label_reason: Performs a focused authentication and token-security audit on an existing NestJS implementation.

prompt: Analyze our public GraphQL API deployed on Apollo Server for security weaknesses including unbounded nested query depth DoS, batching brute-force attacks on `/login`, and exposed introspection schemas in production.
label_reason: API security review targeting GraphQL-specific attack vectors on an existing server.

prompt: Explain how an attacker could chain a prototype pollution bug in our Node.js JSON merge utility with a Handlebars template rendering path to achieve remote code execution, and write the formal CVE-style vulnerability disclosure.
label_reason: Explains an exploit chain and drafts a vulnerability report for an existing codebase without requesting application feature implementation.

prompt: Create low- and high-fidelity Figma wireframes for a pediatric telemedicine mobile app, covering the parent onboarding flow, symptom photo upload screens, and waiting-room video consultation states without writing any code.
label_reason: Requests Figma wireframes and screen mockups for a mobile app with an explicit exclusion of programming.

prompt: Define a comprehensive multi-brand design system specification including an 8pt spacing grid, WCAG AAA dark/light color tokens, modular typographic scale, and elevation shadows for our enterprise analytics suite.
label_reason: Focuses strictly on typography, color systems, and spacing design tokens with no software implementation.

prompt: Map out an end-to-end user journey diagram and service blueprint for first-time electric vehicle buyers comparing battery lease plans, highlighting emotional friction points, dealer touchpoints, and drop-off stages.
label_reason: Deliverable is a UX research user journey diagram and service blueprint with no coding involved.

prompt: Design interactive clickable Figma prototypes and visual layout concepts for a luxury watch auction landing page, including micro-interaction timing specs for the countdown timer and bid history drawer.
label_reason: Requests clickable Figma visual prototypes and interaction specifications without frontend or backend code.

prompt: Critique the visual hierarchy, information density, and color contrast of our warehouse robotics monitoring dashboard mockup, and propose a cleaner 12-column grid layout for the telemetry cards.
label_reason: Evaluates dashboard visual design and layout hierarchy on a mockup rather than implementing code.

prompt: Write the component styling and anatomy documentation for our split-button, toast alert, and multi-select combobox patterns in Zeroheight so our React and iOS teams have consistent padding, border-radius, and focus-ring specs.
label_reason: Although React and iOS teams are mentioned as consumers, the task is writing visual component styling documentation in Zeroheight without programming.

prompt: Synthesize findings from 18 usability test sessions on our municipal tax filing portal into a UX research report with persona cards, task-completion heatmaps, and navigation tree restructuring recommendations.
label_reason: Produces UX research documentation, personas, and information architecture recommendations without software development.

prompt: Make my application better and more reliable for daily users.
label_reason: Provides no details on what the application does, its technology stack, or whether improvements belong in the UI, backend, or infrastructure.

prompt: Our regional logistics company is losing customers because the current order workflow feels outdated and slow during peak holiday weeks. We want to modernize the experience before Q4 so staff and clients stop complaining.
label_reason: Describes a business problem with an outdated, slow workflow, but lacks technical context to tell if it needs UX redesign, frontend work, backend optimization, or a full rebuild.

prompt: Fix my system—people are saying the numbers on the monthly summary do not match what they expected after Tuesday's update.
label_reason: Impossible to determine whether the calculation mismatch stems from frontend formatting, an API aggregation bug, or corrupt database records.

prompt: I need a complete management solution for my chain of three dental clinics in Kochi so we can handle daily operations more smoothly.
label_reason: Requests a broad 'management solution' without specifying whether they want UX prototypes, a custom web application, a backend integration, or off-the-shelf software advice.

prompt: Build something modern for our college hackathon club that really stands out to sponsors this semester.
label_reason: Does not specify whether the deliverable is a graphic design deck, a static landing page, or a full event registration platform.

prompt: We migrated our workspace last weekend and now everything feels sluggish whenever the finance team opens their workspace at 9 AM. Can you analyze what is going wrong and speed it up?
label_reason: Lacks architectural details to identify whether the slowdown is in client rendering, network API latency, or database query locks.

prompt: Improve the user experience of our subscription checkout flow so fewer trial visitors abandon the page before finishing.
label_reason: Ambiguous whether the request calls for UX research/wireframes, frontend UI code changes, or faster payment gateway backend processing.

prompt: Build a responsive solar inverter monitoring dashboard in React and Tailwind CSS that consumes our existing `/api/v1/telemetry` REST endpoint and renders real-time kilowatt-hour line charts with Recharts.
label_reason: Requires building only the React and Tailwind CSS client dashboard consuming an already available backend REST endpoint.

prompt: Create a multi-step customs declaration form in Angular using Reactive Forms and Zod validation, including conditional tariff code fields, client-side CSV row parsing, and inline error summaries.
label_reason: Strictly client-side form implementation and validation in Angular with no backend or database work.

prompt: Refactor our Vue 3 e-commerce product catalog page to meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards by adding keyboard roving tabindex to the size selector, ARIA live regions for filter counts, and responsive CSS Grid breakpoints.
label_reason: Focuses purely on client-side accessibility and responsive layout improvements in an existing Vue 3 interface.

prompt: Develop a static portfolio and case-study website for an architectural studio using Next.js static export (`output: 'export'`) and Framer Motion page transitions, deployed purely as static assets with no server runtime.
label_reason: Uses Next.js strictly as a static site generator with client-side animations and no backend runtime, API, or database.

prompt: Implement an interactive financial ledger table component in React using TanStack Table with column pinning, multi-column sorting, client-side CSV export, and an OAuth bearer token header passed to our existing `/v2/transactions` API.
label_reason: Builds a client-side React data table that attaches an auth header to an already existing API without requiring backend implementation.

prompt: Build an offline-first browser Pomodoro and task timer single-page app in vanilla TypeScript and HTML5 Canvas that persists session history purely in browser `localStorage`.
label_reason: Runs entirely in the browser using TypeScript, HTML5 Canvas, and client-side localStorage.

prompt: Fix a stale closure bug in our React Native tournament bracket screen where tapping 'Refresh Seedings' re-renders the old match array instead of displaying the latest JSON payload returned by our GraphQL query hook.
label_reason: Resolves a client-side state and hook rendering bug in React Native consuming an already working GraphQL endpoint.

prompt: Create a client-side Mapbox GL JS store locator widget in Vue that filters 200 GeoJSON branch coordinates by driving radius and displays store opening hours in a slide-over drawer.
label_reason: Implements a frontend-only Vue map widget integrating the Mapbox GL JS client SDK with static GeoJSON data.

prompt: Build a FastAPI microservice that exposes REST endpoints to calculate cold-chain shipping tariffs, stores rate tables in PostgreSQL via SQLAlchemy, and syncs live diesel surcharges from the EIA public API every six hours.
label_reason: Purely server-side REST service in FastAPI with PostgreSQL persistence and external API synchronization, with no UI requested.

prompt: Implement a background Celery worker in Django backed by Redis that processes nightly warehouse stock reconciliation CSVs from AWS S3, updates inventory ledgers in PostgreSQL, and retries dead-letter tasks with exponential backoff.
label_reason: Implements an asynchronous server-side background job pipeline with database and S3 integration and no frontend or REST API.

prompt: Develop a standalone NestJS authentication and RBAC token service using Passport, Redis session blacklisting, and PostgreSQL user credentials, exposing `/auth/login`, `/auth/refresh`, and `/auth/revoke` endpoints for internal microservices.
label_reason: Creates a backend-only authentication service in NestJS rather than auditing an existing system or building a UI.

prompt: Optimize our Express, MongoDB, and Mongoose tournament leaderboard aggregation pipeline by replacing N+1 `findById` loops with a single `$lookup` and compound index on `(tournamentId, status, points)`.
label_reason: Focuses strictly on server-side MongoDB/Mongoose query optimization inside an Express endpoint.

prompt: Write a Flask webhook receiver service that verifies HMAC-SHA256 signatures on incoming Shopify order events and forwards normalized payloads to our internal RabbitMQ exchange without storing any state in a database.
label_reason: Stateless server-side webhook integration between Shopify and RabbitMQ in Flask with no database or UI.

prompt: Fix a deadlock in our Go billing engine where concurrent goroutines updating subscription credits in PostgreSQL acquire row locks in opposite orders during prorated plan upgrades.
label_reason: Resolves a server-side concurrency and database transaction locking bug in Go and PostgreSQL.
